 


## Inicipit

Buffalo 1st March 57

 

My Brother Nelson

 

Your Eldest son Friend *my nephew* informs me that at the last news from you all were well & busy making ready to build a new House all of which I was glad to hear as a Brother should be it does me good to hear from or *of* you all so often, thanks to the wonderful facilities of the post office arrangements, which will give us news from Vermont by the way of Wisconsin
